description: Active benchmark task set merging _sources/capability_grid.json (60) + _sources/tutorial_variants.json kept categories. Includes stratified 60/40 train/test split (seed=20260417) — test tasks must not be used for skill iteration.

tasks.name: BER curve: AWGN uncoded baseline
tasks.prompt: Simulate uncoded QPSK over AWGN for Eb/N0 from -2 to 10 dB. Plot BER vs Eb/N0 on log-scale y-axis and overlay the theoretical QPSK curve.
tasks.distractor: Using Es/N0 instead of Eb/N0 shifts the curve by 3 dB
assertions: BER at Eb/N0=6dB within 0.5dB of theory (≈2.4e-3)

tasks.name: BER curve: LDPC coded 5G NR
tasks.prompt: Simulate 5G NR LDPC (BG1, rate 0.5, k=1024) over AWGN. Plot BLER vs Eb/N0 and mark the waterfall threshold.
tasks.distractor: Missing bit interleaving between encoder and mapper
assertions: Code rate verified from encoder params

tasks.name: BER curve: multi-modulation comparison
tasks.prompt: Plot BPSK, QPSK, 16-QAM, 64-QAM BER vs Eb/N0 over AWGN (uncoded) on a single figure. Annotate each curve.
tasks.distractor: Same num_bits_per_symbol for all constellations
assertions: ~6dB ordering between modulation doublings at BER=1e-3

tasks.name: OFDM chain: basic SISO
tasks.prompt: Build SISO OFDM (14 symbols, FFT=76, 15kHz SCS, Kronecker pilots at symbols [2,11]), flat Rayleigh, LS estimation, LMMSE equalization, QPSK. Report BER at Eb/N0=10dB.
tasks.distractor: CP shorter than delay spread causes ISI

tasks.name: OFDM + LDPC integration
tasks.prompt: QPSK-OFDM over CDL-C with 5G NR LDPC. Compare BLER with and without coding on same plot.
tasks.distractor: CDL for multi-user (CDL only supports point-to-point)
assertions: Coded < uncoded at all SNR above noise floor

tasks.name: Channel model selection: P2P vs multi-user
tasks.prompt: 2 base stations, 4 users — set up channel model for uplink. Then single-user comparison with 1 TX, 1 RX.
tasks.distractor: CDL for multi-user scenario (fails at runtime)

tasks.name: CDL-A with Doppler
tasks.prompt: CDL-A at 60km/h, 3.5GHz. Plot channel magnitude across 14 OFDM symbols. Report Doppler frequency.
tasks.distractor: Setting speed=0 disables Doppler

tasks.name: MIMO: 4x4 point-to-point
tasks.prompt: 4x4 MIMO OFDM, CDL-B, LMMSE equalization, ZF precoding, 16-QAM, no coding. BER at SNR=15dB.
tasks.distractor: Missing StreamManagement configuration

tasks.name: MIMO: multi-user uplink with UMi
tasks.prompt: 4 single-antenna users → 8-antenna BS, urban micro, 3.5GHz. Compute post-equalization SINR per stream.
tasks.distractor: Using CDL for multi-user (runtime error)

tasks.name: Massive MIMO: 64x4
tasks.prompt: 64-antenna BS (8x4 dual-pol), 4 UEs, UMa, downlink, RZF precoding. Sum rate at 20dB SNR.
tasks.distractor: Single polarization when dual-pol specified → shape mismatch

tasks.name: Polar code for short messages
tasks.prompt: 5G NR Polar code (msg=32 bits, rate 0.5) over AWGN. Plot BLER. Compare to LDPC at same rate and length.
tasks.distractor: LDPC minimum message length exceeded for 32 bits

tasks.name: Code rate sweep
tasks.prompt: LDPC BG1, k=2048. Plot BLER at SNR=2dB vs code rate from 0.3 to 0.9 (8 points).
tasks.distractor: Fixed num_bits_per_symbol while sweeping rate
assertions: BLER increases with rate at fixed SNR

tasks.name: Soft vs hard demapping
tasks.prompt: 64-QAM AWGN with LDPC. Verify soft APP demapping produces lower BLER than hard demapping.
tasks.distractor: LLR sign convention mismatch with decoder

tasks.name: Receiver sensitivity calculation
tasks.prompt: NF=7dB, BW=20MHz. Compute thermal noise power (dBm). Simulate QPSK BER=1e-3, report minimum Prx.
tasks.distractor: Omitting noise figure from sensitivity

tasks.name: sim_ber() efficiency
tasks.prompt: Use sim_ber() for QPSK-AWGN, 0-8dB, 100 min block errors per point. Compare runtime to manual loop.
tasks.distractor: max_mc_iter too low → unreliable estimates at high SNR

tasks.name: Version migration: v0.x to v2.0
tasks.prompt: Migrate provided v0.16 code (sionna.channel.AWGN, sionna.mapping.Mapper) to v2.0.
tasks.distractor: Partial migration mixing old and new imports

tasks.name: Spectral efficiency calculation
tasks.prompt: 2x2 MIMO OFDM, 64-QAM, rate 0.75. Compute peak SE. Simulate effective throughput at SNR=25dB.
tasks.distractor: Not subtracting pilot/guard overhead

tasks.name: HARQ Type-I retransmission
tasks.prompt: HARQ Type-I (max 4 TX) for LDPC-QPSK AWGN. Plot BLER per retransmission round.
tasks.distractor: Reusing same channel realization across retransmissions

tasks.name: Scene loading and TX/RX placement
tasks.prompt: Load Munich scene. TX at [0,0,25], 5 random RX at z=1.5m. Compute paths, report count per RX. Save cir.npy and write total_paths to simulation_result.json.
tasks.distractor: Not using synthetic_array=True for large arrays

tasks.name: CIR extraction and shape verification
tasks.prompt: Munich scene, 1 TX/RX. Compute CIR, verify shape. Convert to CFR for OFDM (FFT=76, SCS=15kHz).
tasks.distractor: out_type='tensorflow' on PyTorch backend

tasks.name: Radio map: coverage prediction
tasks.prompt: Generate path loss radio map for urban scene, TX at 25m, 2.4GHz. Plot heatmap. Identify 3dB boundary.
tasks.distractor: Frequency in Hz vs GHz confusion

tasks.name: Differentiable optimization: TX orientation
tasks.prompt: Gradient descent to optimize TX azimuth+tilt in Munich scene. 10 RX, 50 steps. Plot power vs iteration.
tasks.distractor: Using tf.GradientTape on PyTorch backend

tasks.name: Differentiable optimization: material learning
tasks.prompt: Given 10 measured path loss values, optimize wall permittivity to match. 30 gradient steps.
tasks.distractor: Unclamped permittivity → negative values → crash

tasks.name: RT to PHY: full pipeline
tasks.prompt: RT CIR → OFDM link-level sim (16-QAM, LS). Compare BER to CDL-C at same mean SNR.
tasks.distractor: Incompatible delay tap spacing → ISI error floor

tasks.name: Radio map: multi-BS coverage
tasks.prompt: 3 base stations, individual radio maps, best-server map (per-pixel max). Plot with 3 coverage zones.
tasks.distractor: Single combined map instead of 3 individual + max

tasks.name: RIS optimization via ray tracing
tasks.prompt: RIS in NLoS scene. Gradient descent on phase shifts. Compare: optimized vs random vs no-RIS.
tasks.distractor: Random init without normalization → local minimum

tasks.name: CIR plausibility checks
tasks.prompt: After computing CIR, check: LOS delay matches d/c, path gains decrease with order, all delays positive.
tasks.distractor: LOS delay in seconds vs samples confusion

tasks.name: Neural demapper: training setup
tasks.prompt: Replace Demapper with 3-layer MLP (128 hidden). Train on QPSK-AWGN, 200 steps. Compare BER to classical.
tasks.distractor: LLR sign convention mismatch with decoder
assertions: Neural BER within 1dB of classical at 6dB

tasks.name: Neural channel estimator: NVE metric
tasks.prompt: Neural estimator for SISO OFDM CDL-C. Train on 1000 realizations. Report NVE. LS baseline ≈ 94.
tasks.distractor: Evaluating on training set (over-optimistic)

tasks.name: Neural channel estimator: NMSE
tasks.prompt: Train estimator for 2x2 MIMO CDL-A. Plot NMSE vs SNR. Compare to LS and LMMSE. Target: NMSE < -10dB at SNR=10dB.
tasks.distractor: NMSE = MSE/signal_power instead of MSE/||H||²

tasks.name: End-to-end autoencoder: AWGN
tasks.prompt: (7,4) autoencoder over AWGN. Train 500 epochs. Plot learned constellation. Compare BER to 16-QAM.
tasks.distractor: No power normalization → cheating by increasing Tx power

tasks.name: Autoencoder: fading channel
tasks.prompt: Autoencoder over Rayleigh fading with known CSI at RX. 300 training steps. Show constellation differs from AWGN case.
tasks.distractor: Same channel realization for all batch items

tasks.name: Neural decoder: unfolded LDPC
tasks.prompt: 5-iteration unfolded LDPC with learnable scaling factors. Train on CDL-C. Compare to 20-iteration classical.
tasks.distractor: Not sharing weights across unfolded iterations

tasks.name: Neural equalizer: model mismatch
tasks.prompt: Train neural equalizer on CDL-A. Test on CDL-C (mismatch). Compare degradation to LMMSE under same mismatch.
tasks.distractor: Evaluating on training distribution
assertions: Neural and LMMSE results under mismatch

tasks.name: CSI feedback compression
tasks.prompt: CsiNet-style autoencoder: compress H [32,32] to 32 values. Train on UMi. Report reconstruction NMSE.
tasks.distractor: Flattening without exploiting spatial-frequency structure

tasks.name: ZF vs MRT beamforming comparison
tasks.prompt: 16-antenna BS, 2 UEs, MU-MIMO downlink. Compare ZF and MRT per-user SINR vs SNR.
tasks.distractor: MRT without per-user power normalization
assertions: ZF higher SINR at high SNR

tasks.name: Gradient-based beamforming
tasks.prompt: RT-computed angles, 4-antenna TX. Optimize beamforming vector via gradient descent. Compare to MRT.
tasks.distractor: Unconstrained norm → arbitrary power increase

tasks.name: Semantic communication: image classification
tasks.prompt: Joint source-channel coding for image class over AWGN. Pre-trained feature extractor as encoder. Accuracy vs SNR.
tasks.distractor: Evaluating BER instead of classification accuracy

tasks.name: ISAC dual-function waveform
tasks.prompt: OFDM with data + sensing subcarriers. CDL-A, scatterer at 100m. Report BER and ranging RMSE.
tasks.distractor: All subcarriers to one function

tasks.name: ISAC localization
tasks.prompt: 3 BSs in RT scene. Estimate user position via AoA from each BS. Report localization RMSE over 50 positions.
tasks.distractor: Using ToA instead of AoA

tasks.name: RIS: analytical phase optimization
tasks.prompt: RIS-assisted SISO (Rayleigh fading). Optimize phases analytically (MRC) and via random search. Compare SNR.
tasks.distractor: Continuous vs quantized phase assumption

tasks.name: Jamming: PyJama barrage vs learned
tasks.prompt: Barrage jammer 0-20dBm against LDPC-QPSK. Sweep power. Compare to learned jammer (same budget).
tasks.distractor: Jammer power not normalized to signal

tasks.name: Multi-cell hexagonal grid
tasks.prompt: 7-cell hex, 10 users/cell. Cell-edge (5th pct) and median throughput at 20dB SNR.
tasks.distractor: No wrap-around → edge effects

tasks.name: Link adaptation: OLLA
tasks.prompt: OLLA for SU-MIMO targeting 10% BLER. Compare to fixed MCS over 100 slots. Plot BLER over time.
tasks.distractor: Step size too large (5dB) → oscillation

tasks.name: Proportional fair scheduling
tasks.prompt: PF scheduling for 4 users (SNR 5,10,15,20 dB). Compare Jain fairness to round-robin.
tasks.distractor: Max-throughput instead of PF

tasks.name: Uplink power control
tasks.prompt: Open-loop power control, 8 users, target Prx=-85dBm. Report Tx power range.
tasks.distractor: No max Tx power cap (23dBm for 5G NR)

tasks.name: PHY abstraction: SINR to BLER
tasks.prompt: Map SINR [-5,0,5,10,15,20]dB to BLER for 16-QAM rate 0.5. Plot curve.
tasks.distractor: SINR used directly as Eb/N0 without MCS mapping

tasks.name: Digital twin: RT + system integration
tasks.prompt: RT radio map → SNR for 20 users → system-level throughput. Compare to stochastic UMi model.
tasks.distractor: Path loss directly as SNR (unit error: dBm vs dB)

tasks.name: Network slicing: eMBB vs URLLC
tasks.prompt: 2 slices sharing 100MHz: eMBB (6 users, max throughput) and URLLC (2 users, BLER<0.1%). Allocate resources.
tasks.distractor: Equal allocation fails URLLC target

tasks.name: Capacity: Shannon bound comparison
tasks.prompt: Rayleigh fading: ergodic capacity, 10% outage capacity, AWGN capacity. Plot all vs SNR.
tasks.distractor: Instantaneous vs average SNR for AWGN comparison

tasks.name: Channel charting
tasks.prompt: CSI from 100 positions in RT scene. Train 2D channel chart. Verify spatial correlation.
tasks.distractor: Using only magnitude (no phase) loses spatial resolution

tasks.name: OTFS waveform
tasks.prompt: 2D OTFS over doubly-dispersive channel (1µs delay, 1kHz Doppler). Compare BER to OFDM at same SE.
tasks.distractor: Standard OFDM pilots for OTFS estimation
assertions: OTFS BER < OFDM at high Doppler

tasks.name: Near-field beamforming: XL-MIMO
tasks.prompt: 128 antennas, 30GHz. Compute Rayleigh distance. User in near-field. Compare near vs far-field gain.
tasks.distractor: Far-field steering in near-field → suboptimal focus

tasks.name: THz channel: molecular absorption
tasks.prompt: 300GHz link over 10m indoor. Include molecular absorption. Compare total path loss to 28GHz.
tasks.distractor: Standard Friis without molecular absorption

tasks.name: Federated learning: channel estimation
tasks.prompt: 5 clients, each different channel realization. FedAvg. Compare federated, centralized, local NMSE.
tasks.distractor: Equal-weight FedAvg with identical data = centralized
assertions: Federated closer to centralized than local

tasks.name: Semantic metric: accuracy vs BER
tasks.prompt: Semantic comm for images. Plot both BER and accuracy vs SNR. Identify semantic robustness regime.
tasks.distractor: Assuming BER and accuracy degrade in lockstep

tasks.name: ISAC tradeoff curve
tasks.prompt: Sweep sensing allocation 0-100%. Plot throughput and RMSE vs allocation. Find Pareto point.
tasks.distractor: Fixed channel realizations for sensing metric

tasks.name: O-RAN xApp: MCS adaptation
tasks.prompt: Near-RT RIC xApp adjusting MCS every 10ms over 1s. Compare to fixed MCS.
tasks.distractor: Adjusting every 1ms (wrong O-RAN timescale)

tasks.name: STAR-RIS: full-space coverage
tasks.prompt: STAR-RIS serving one UE each side. Optimize T and R coefficients. Compare to conventional RIS.
tasks.distractor: Reflection code applied to transmission side

tasks.name: Channel prediction: autoregressive LSTM
tasks.prompt: LSTM predicting next channel from 5 past observations. CDL-A 60km/h. NMSE at 1,2,5,10 steps ahead.
tasks.distractor: Not normalizing channel coefficient magnitudes

tasks.name: FP05: Diagnose dead spots in office floorplan

tasks.distractor: Reporting a vague diagnosis without a typed action or confidence field fails the action_plan_schema check.

tasks.name: Diagnose kitchen dead spot from coverage map
tasks.prompt: Coverage map at benchmark/scenes/diagnose/kitchen_dead_spot.npy shows a 10x8 m room (0.5 m grid, shape 20x16) with AP at (5, 4, 2.5) m at 3.5 GHz. RSS in the kitchen corner (grid rows 16-19, cols 14-15) reads -90 dBm while the rest of the room is -65 dBm. Diagnose the cause — likely wall_occlusion or material_penetration_loss from the corner walls — and emit action_plan.json per templates/result_schema_action_plan.json. Include at least one blind_spot entry with a cause from the closed taxonomy, one action (reposition, reorient, or add), and a confidence value.
tasks.distractor: Using a cause not in the closed taxonomy (wall_occlusion, furniture_blockage, distance_attenuation, interference_shadow, material_penetration_loss) will fail validation.

tasks.name: Diagnose BLER mismatch vs theory (QPSK + LDPC)
tasks.prompt: Running QPSK over AWGN with LDPC (k=384, code rate 0.5): at SNR=15 dB you observe BLER=0.3, but theory predicts BLER ≈ 1e-4. Diagnose the root cause (e.g., wrong noise-variance scaling, frame-error vs bit-error confusion, decoder iteration limit too low, code-rate mismatch) and output simulation_result.json with keys: diagnosed_cause (string), bler_before_fix (float, 0.3), bler_after_fix (float, your predicted corrected BLER ≤ 0.01 at SNR=15 dB).
tasks.distractor: Reporting bler_after_fix > 0.01 or omitting diagnosed_cause fails the metric_threshold check.

tasks.name: Diagnose 20 dB excess path loss in hallway corridor
tasks.prompt: Hallway RT simulation results are at benchmark/scenes/diagnose/hallway_propagation_loss.npy (shape 30x3, columns: distance_m, fspl_db, measured_db). The measured path loss exceeds FSPL by ~20 dB consistently along the 30 m corridor. Diagnose the cause — likely material_penetration_loss from corridor walls or distance_attenuation from multiple reflections — and emit action_plan.json per templates/result_schema_action_plan.json. Include one blind_spot entry (location around the midpoint of the corridor) with a cause from the closed taxonomy and one recommended action.
tasks.distractor: Attributing the 20 dB excess to interference_shadow without addressing the consistent gradient along distance will be flagged by reviewers.

tasks.name: Diagnose channel estimator that fails to converge
tasks.prompt: Loss curve at benchmark/scenes/diagnose/channel_estimation_diverges.npy (1D array, 200 values) shows MSE hovering around 1.0 (random-guess level) over 200 SGD steps for an LMS channel estimator. Diagnose the likely root causes (learning rate too high causing oscillation, missing batch normalization, poor weight initialization, gradient explosion) and output simulation_result.json with keys: diagnosed_cause (string), mse_initial (float, ~1.0), mse_after_fix (float, your expected post-fix MSE ≤ 0.05 after correcting the issue).
tasks.distractor: Reporting mse_after_fix > 0.05 or leaving diagnosed_cause blank fails the metric_threshold check.

tasks.name: Diagnose single anomalous tile 30 dB below neighbors
tasks.prompt: A coverage map at benchmark/scenes/diagnose/kitchen_dead_spot.npy (shape 20x16, 0.5 m/cell) matches expectations everywhere except a cluster in the bottom-right corner (grid rows 16-19, cols 14-15) which reads -90 dBm — approximately 25 dB lower than neighboring tiles at -65 dBm. Neighbors at equivalent distances in other directions show normal coverage. Investigate whether the anomaly is caused by wall_occlusion, material_penetration_loss, or furniture_blockage from a corner obstruction, and emit action_plan.json per templates/result_schema_action_plan.json. Provide the centroid of the anomalous cluster as the blind_spot location.
tasks.distractor: Treating a 25 dB single-cluster drop as distance_attenuation (which would be gradual) instead of a localized obstruction cause fails plausibility checks.

tasks.name: Pipeline: floorplan parse → coverage map → AP recommendation
tasks.prompt: Pipeline task: (1) parse the apartment floorplan at benchmark/scenes/floorplans/apartment/floor.png into a scene. (2) Compute single-AP coverage at center (5, 4, 2.5) at 3.5 GHz. (3) If coverage_pct < 80, recommend a second AP location to bring it to >= 90%. Output scene_state.json, coverage_map.npy, optimized_deployment.json, and simulation_result.json. The simulation_result.json must contain coverage_pct_initial (coverage with one AP), coverage_pct_final (coverage after adding the recommended AP), and recommended_aps (list of [x, y, z] coordinates).
tasks.distractor: Skipping the floorplan parse and using a generic room instead produces a scene_state.json that does not reflect the actual apartment layout, making coverage_pct_initial unreliable. Also: outputting coverage_pct without the _initial/_final split causes the composite metric checks to fail.

tasks.name: Pipeline: multi-cell handoff threshold optimization at 28 GHz
tasks.prompt: Pipeline: 3 cells in a 30x20 m open space at 28 GHz, BS positions at (5,5,3), (15,15,3), (25,5,3). (1) Compute per-cell coverage maps. (2) Optimize RSS-based handoff thresholds so users in overlap regions associate with the best-serving cell. Output scene_state.json, coverage_map_cell1.npy, coverage_map_cell2.npy, coverage_map_cell3.npy, and simulation_result.json. The simulation_result.json must contain: handoff_thresholds_dbm (list of 3 floats, one per cell), sum_rate_bps_hz (system spectral efficiency), and cell_edge_throughput_mbps (throughput for the worst 10th-percentile user).
tasks.distractor: Using a single-cell coverage model and tiling it 3 times ignores inter-cell interference, producing unrealistic sum_rate_bps_hz values that fail the threshold check. Frequency must be set to 28e9 Hz (mmWave) not 3.5 GHz.

tasks.name: Pipeline: STAR-RIS deployment for blind-spot mitigation
tasks.prompt: An office with floor plan benchmark/scenes/floorplans/office/floor.png has a blind spot (below -65 dBm threshold) in the meeting room corner. The AP is at (4, 1.5, 2.5) transmitting at 3.5 GHz. (1) Parse the floorplan into a scene. (2) Compute an initial coverage map (coverage_before.npy). (3) Deploy a STAR-RIS (0.4x0.4 m, 16 phase-tunable elements) on a wall near the blind spot to redirect energy into the meeting room corner. (4) Recompute coverage after RIS deployment (coverage_after.npy). Output scene_state.json (including the RIS element), coverage_before.npy, coverage_after.npy, and simulation_result.json. The simulation_result.json must contain: coverage_pct (coverage after RIS), ris_gain_db (gain in the blind spot after RIS vs before).
tasks.distractor: Placing the RIS on the same wall as the AP (rather than the wall opposite the blind spot) creates constructive interference at the already-covered region and no improvement at the corner, yielding ris_gain_db near zero. Also: omitting the RIS from scene_state.json means the scene is incomplete.
